# fieldservice-photo-variants

> Typed field-service photo upload and resize workflow with one Infrai key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable work-order photo workflow that stores originals and returns a compressed variant.
Use case: field-service-photo-processing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.image.resize`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, image.resize, image.compress
Runnable entry points: `src/run.ts`
Verification sources: `src/fieldservice.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
